category_title: Angry and confrontational youth prone to lashing out at teachers
scenario_title: Customer interactions and conflict management in retail placement
minimal_context: Liam is working at the front counter of a sports retail store and needs to help a customer process a return.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Liam, please go to the front counter and help that customer process their return.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Fine. But that guy is already giving me an attitude and treating me like I don't know what I'm doing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go over there and see what he needs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I did, and he's complaining about the store policy. I'm getting really angry because he won't even listen to me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to explain it to him again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I'm not going to just stand here and let him talk to me like that. I'm going to go back out there and tell him exactly where he can shove his return!

task.content: Interacting with customers and managing interpersonal conflicts
task.learning_goal: Developing people skills and learning about life and society

context.social_setting: Work placement interacting with customers, supervisors, and adult mentors

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Situations involving interpersonal conflicts with other people, especially customers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Getting in confrontations with other people
related_quotes: I was really angry … but since co-op I can let that all go … Now I’m able to think before I act. I’m able to walk away from situations and not get in confrontations with other people, especially customers.

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing situations that provoke anger before learning to regulate his behavior
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Acting without thinking and getting into confrontations
